Death Throttle - Kakuzetsu Toshi kara no.name: Quarantine
Death Throttle - Kakuzetsu Toshi kara no.summary: You have to transport people in this dangerous area. When you see someone with a sign hovering over him, stop by and pick him up. The destination place is visible on your minimap. For every ride you get some money. When you have enough money go to the garage where you can upgrade your car with plenty of weapons.
